column3: Hearing of faith is rendered “hearing with faith.”
The passive being completed is rendered “finishing.”
“God” supplies the subject; hearing of faith is expanded as “hear and believe.”
The present justifies is rendered “would justify”; in you is rendered “through you.”
“The man” matches the Textus Receptus (ἄνθρωπος); “in them” is rendered “by them.”
The active no one cancels is recast as the passive “cannot be canceled.”
“The Scripture” supplies the subject of says.
“Was ... given” is supplied in the opening question; “by a mediator” replaces in the hand of a mediator.
“Is unnecessary” expands is not of one.
“Pronounces” is supplied; the genitive faith of Jesus Christ is rendered “faith in Jesus Christ.”
And between male and female is rendered “nor.”
